apply_page.statutory_annual_info: BCEA §20: Malatsi a tiro a {minDays} a matlhotlhapelo a ngwaga mo mophatlalatsong. {accrual}
apply_page.statutory_sick_info: BCEA §23: Matlhotlhapelo a bolwetse a lekanngwa mo mophatlalatsong wa dingwaga di le 3 (malatsi a 36 bakeng sa beke ya malatsi a 5). Setifikeiti sa ngaka se a tlhokega morago ga malatsi a a latelanang a le 2, ka Mosupologo/Labotlhano, kgotsa fa palogotlhe ya go seyo ya beke tse 8 e feta malatsi a 6.
apply_page.statutory_frl_info: BCEA §27: Malatsi a {cap} a Matlhotlhapelo a Boikarabelo jwa Lelapa mo mophatlalatsong wa matlhotlhapelo a ngwaga. Ditiragalo tse di tshwanetsweng: tsholo ya ngwana, bolwetse jwa ngwana, loso lwa leloko la lelapa le le gaufi.
apply_page.statutory_maternity_info: BCEA §25: Dikgwedi tse 4 tse di latelanang tsa matlhotlhapelo a botsadi a a sa duelweng. Sedikwe se se dumeletsweng sa matlhotlhapelo a batsadi se tshwanetse go kwadisiwa mo HR pele ga go kopa.
apply_page.statutory_parental_info: Van Wyk 2025 / BCEA §25A: Matlhotlhapelo a batsadi a tlhoka sedikwe se se dumeletsweng se se kwadisitsweng ke HR. Diura tse di abetsweng di ntshiwa mo sedikweng; melao ya matlhotlhapelo a a tsamaisanang e a dirisiwa.
apply_page.statutory_study_info: Matlhotlhapelo a thuto a ikaegile ka tumelelo ya bolaodi le dikwalo tse di tshegetsang (bopaki jwa kwadiso / kitsiso ya tlhatlhobo).
apply_page.statutory_unpaid_info: Matlhotlhapelo a a sa duelweng ga a na go duelwa. Tumelelo e ikaegile ka tlhopho ya tlhogo ya lefapha la gago le HR.

guides.facebook:
1. Ya kwa akhaonto ya gago ya Meta Business / Developers.
2. Tlhama Page Access Token e e nang le tetla ya pages_manage_posts.
3. Kopolola Page ID ya gago (mo About/Settings ya Page) le token fa tlase.
guides.x:
1. Ya kwa developer.x.com mme o bule app ya gago.
2. Tlhama OAuth 2.0 user access token e e nang le tweet.write scope.
3. Manega token fa tlase.
guides.linkedin:
1. Ya kwa linkedin.com/developers mme o bule app ya gago.
2. Bona access token e e nang le w_member_social scope.
3. Manega author URN ya gago (urn:li:person:XXXX) le token fa tlase.
guides.instagram:
1. Instagram ya gago e tshwanetse go nna Business account e e golaganeng le Facebook Page.
2. Bona token e e nang le tetla ya instagram_content_publish.
3. Manega Instagram user ID ya gago le token fa tlase.
guides.whatsapp:
1. Baakanya WhatsApp Cloud API mo Meta.
2. Kopolola access token ya gago e e sa feleng.
3. Manega nomoro ya mogala ya moamogedi (le khoutu ya naga) le token fa tlase.

ext_hint.facebook: Page ID ya gago ya Facebook (dinomoro fela)

skills_levy.what_this_is: Mogolo o duela lekgetho la tlhabololo ya bokgoni kgwedi le kgwedi le EMP201. Karolo e le nngwe mo di tlhano ya lona e ka busetswa jaaka thuso e e patelesegang, mme fela ke mothapi yo o romelang Leano la Bokgoni la Lefelo la Tiro pele ga 30 Moranang.
skills_levy.exempt: Ka fa tlase ga molelwane wa R500 000 — o gololesegile
skills_levy.all_good: Ga go sepe se se setseng mo ngwageng ono wa lekgetho.

councils.description: Makgetho a lekgotla, dikelo tse a balwang ka tsona, le gore a akaretsa badiri bafe.
councils.how_it_works: Lekgetho le ntshiwa mo mogolong mongwe le mongwe wa badiri bao lekgotla le ba akaretsang, mme le duelwa le monyetla wa mothapi. Boleloko ke ka motho ka mongwe: mothapi a le mongwe gantsi o na le badiri ba ba akaretswang le ba ba sa akaretswang mo mogolong o le mongwe.
councils.beneficiary_hint: Letlole mo skrining sa dituelo tsa batho ba bangwe le le amogelang lekgetho leno.
councils.no_beneficiary: Ga go letlole le le golagantsweng, ka jalo lekgetho le ntshiwa mme ga go sepe se se rulaganyang go le duela.
councils.no_rate: Ga go selekanyo se se kwadilweng — ga go sepe se se tla ntshiwang.
councils.fixed_line: {employee} mo modiring, {employer} mo mothaping, paka nngwe le nngwe.
councils.percent_line: {employee}% mo modiring le {employer}% mo mothaping, e beilwe molelwane wa {ceiling}.
councils.nobody_covered: Ga go motho yo o akareditsweng ke lekgotla leno gone jaana.
councils.rate_help: Tshwetso e e dirang e tswalwa letsatsi pele eno e simolola, ka jalo ga go letsatsi le le akareditsweng gabedi.
councils.ceiling_hint: Makgotla a beya molelwane mo makgethong a diphesente. Ntle le ona yo o amogelang madi a mantsi o ntshiwa go feta tekano kgwedi le kgwedi.
councils.source_hint: Fa palo e tswang, sek. kitsiso ya gazette ya lekgotla
councils.members_help: Fela badiri bao lekgotla leno le ba akaretsang. Go oketsa botlhe go phoso jaaka go se oketse ope.

report_sources.projects: Go tswa mo diporojekeng ka botsone — Diporojeke, mme o bule nngwe.
report_sources.work: Go tswa mo tsebeng ya Tiro ya porojeke nngwe le nngwe, kwa popego le ditiro tsa yona di agiwang teng.
report_sources.dependencies: Go tswa mo go Tiro → Golaganya ditiro, kwa tiro e le nngwe e dirwang gore e emele e nngwe.
report_sources.schedule: E balwa ke morulaganyi go tswa mo boleeleng jwa ditiro le dikgolagano tsa tsona. E dirise mo tsebeng ya Lenaneo la porojeke.
report_sources.baseline: E bapisa gompieno le motheo o o bolokilweng. Boloka o mongwe mo tsebeng ya Lenaneo la porojeke.
report_sources.recurrence: Go tswa mo molaong wa go boelediwa mo teng ga tiro, mo tsebeng ya Tiro.
report_sources.evidence: Go tswa mo rejisetareng ya bosupi — sedirisiwa sa mo nageng, baromedi ba dimodule le API ya go tsenya.
report_sources.figures: E tswa mo bosuping. Leba tsebe ya Dipalo ya porojeke gore o bone melao e e kwa morago ga palo nngwe le nngwe.
report_sources.timesheets: Go tswa mo go Kabo → Nako mo porojekeng. Tsenya batho pele mo thepeng ya Batho — diura di kwalwa ka leloko.
report_sources.assignments: Go tswa mo go Tiro, ka go naya leloko tiro, ka diperesente tsa kabo. Tsenya batho pele mo go Kabo → Batho.
report_sources.labour: Diura tse di amogetsweng × tuelo. Baya tuelo fa o kwala diura mo go Kabo → Nako; ke diura tse di amogetsweng fela tse di balwang.
report_sources.costs: Go tswa mo go Kabo → Ditshenyegelo mo porojekeng, kwa didirisiwa, metjhini le bakonteraka ba ka fa tlase di kwalwang teng. Ke tse di amogetsweng le tse di duetsweng fela tse di balwang.
report_sources.members: Go tswa mo go Kabo → Batho mo porojekeng.
report_sources.approvals: Di tlhamiwa ka boiketlo fa diura kgotsa ditshenyegelo di romelwa. Gore ke mang yo o dirang tshwetso go beiwa mo go Setup → Tsamaiso ya ditetla.
report_sources.links: Go tswa mo tsebeng ya porojeke, ka go golaganya rekoto ya module e nngwe — thoto, oda ya go reka, konteraka.
report_sources.registers: E kwadilwe mo lenaneong la porojeke la dikotsi, mathata le diphetogo

registers.title: Dikotsi, mathata le diphetogo

registers.issues_sub: Se se diragetseng, le ka fa se baakantsweng ka teng

registers.change_sub: Bolela tshusumetso pele go tsewa tshwetso — ke sona se se dirang gore tshwetso e nne le bokao.

registers.no_changes: Ga go na dikopo tsa phetogo.

registers.field_mitigation: Se re se dirang ka yona

registers.review_hint: Kotsi e go se nang ope yo o e tlhatlhobang ke kotsi e e se nang mong.
registers.field_closure_note: Ke ka ntlha yang e tswalwa

registers.field_resolution: Ka fa bo rarabolotsweng ka teng

registers.preventative_hint: Se se thibelang gore bo diragale gape.

registers.field_reason: Ke ka ntlha yang e kopiwa
registers.reason_hint: Ke sona se yo o amogelang a se balang pele.

registers.impact_days_hint: Palo e e kwa tlase ga lefela e atametsa letsatsi.
registers.field_impact_risk: Dikotsi tse dintšha kgotsa tse di fetotsweng
registers.realise_note: Kotsi e nna mo lenaneong jaaka e diragetseng, mme bothata jo bosha bo supa morago go yona — kgolagano eo ke bosupi jwa gore go ne go na le mongwe yo o e boneng e tla.

registers.close_needs_note: Bolela gore ke ka ntlha yang kotsi e tswalwa.
registers.needs_root_cause: Tiragalo kgotsa bothata jwa botlhokwa bo tshwanetse go kwala sesosa sa jona sa konokono.
registers.change_not_editable: Kopo eo ya phetogo e mo mothong yo o amogelang.
registers.change_not_approved: Ke phetogo e e amogetsweng fela e e ka dirisiwang.
registers.no_flow_auto: Ga go na tsela ya tetla e e diretsweng dikopo tsa phetogo mo lefelong leno la tiro, ka jalo e kwadilwe jaaka e amogetswe.

data_sources.title: Metswedi ya tshedimosetso
data_sources.subtitle: Metswedi e khamphani eno e netefatsang barekisi ka yona, se motswedi mongwe le mongwe o ka se arabang, le ditlhatlhobo tse go se nang motho yo o ka di arabang.
data_sources.automated_checks: Ditlhatlhobo tse di nang le motswedi
data_sources.ledger_broken: Ketane ya bosupi ga e dumalane mo tsenyong ya {at} ({reason}). Tsaya bosupi jo bo amegang jaaka jo bo sa netefadiwang go fitlha go batlisisiwa.
data_sources.coverage_help: Tlhatlhobo nngwe le nngwe e moduli ono o itseng go e dira, le gore ke mang yo o e arabang gompieno. Tlhatlhobo e e se nang motswedi ga e fetwe — e begwa jaaka e e sa bonaleng go fitlha motho a e dira mme a bega se a se bonyeng.
data_sources.manual_notice: Ditlhatlhobo tse {count} ga di na motswedi o o baakantsweng, ka jalo motho o tshwanetse go di dira mme a bege se a se bonyeng.
data_sources.enable_help: Fa seno se timilwe, ditlhatlhobo tse o neng o tla di araba di begwa jaaka tse di sa bonaleng go na le gore di fete.
data_sources.credentials_help: Di sireleditswe kwa di bolokilweng teng mme ga di ke di busediwa mo skrineng seno. Tsenya senotlolo go se fetola; dinotlolo tse o sa di kwaleng gape di a bolokwa.
data_sources.enabled_checks: Ditlhatlhobo tse motswedi ono o ka di arabang
data_sources.default_for_help: Fa metswedi e e fetang o le mongwe e ka araba tlhatlhobo, ono o botswa pele.
data_sources.monthly_quota_help: Metswedi e e duelelwang e ja madi ka mogala mongwe le mongwe. Fa kabelo e fedile, ditlhatlhobo di begwa jaaka tse di sa bonaleng go na le go go duedisa.
data_sources.endpoints_help: Aterese e akhaonto ya gago e e letleletsweng e e nayang tlhatlhobo nngwe le nngwe. Mafelo a go tlatsa a tlatswa go tswa go morekisi.
data_sources.endpoint_hint: Mafelo a go tlatsa: registration_number, company_name, vat_number, tax_reference_number, account_number, reference
data_sources.manual_provider_note: E nna e bonala. Motho o dira tlhatlhobo kwa motsweding mme a bega se a se bonyeng — e tsena mo bukeng e le nngwe ya ditemoso, ka tsenyo ya bosupi e e tshwanang, e kwadilwe mo leineng la gagwe.
data_sources.none_match: Ga go na motswedi o o dumalanang le seo.
data_sources.profiled: Ditlhatlhobo tse {count} di setse di itse kwa di letsang gone. Tsenya ditokomane tsa gago mme di tla bereka — masimo a fa tlase ke a konteraka e e farologaneng fela.

verifications.about_person: Ka ga motho mongwe (ga go patelesege)
verifications.observed_help: Kwala se motswedi o se bontshitseng e le ruri. Se bapisiwa le se morekisi a re boleletseng sona, lebala ka lebala, gore pharologano e bonwe go na le gore e amogelwe ka tshepo.

verifications.pin_held: PIN e bolokilwe mo morekising yono, ka jalo seemo sa bone sa go latela lekgetho se ka netefadiwa.
verifications.pin_missing: Ga go PIN jaanong. PIN ya TCS ya morekisi ke tetla ya bone ya gore o netefatse seemo sa bone sa go latela lekgetho.

ownership.title: Beng
ownership.ubos: Beng ba bofelo ba ba solegelwang molemo
ownership.no_ubos: Ga go motho wa mmatota yo o bonweng jaanong. Go fitlha ketane e goroga kwa bathong, ga go motho yo o ka tlhatlhobiwang — khamphani ga e ka ke ya otlhaiwa mme ga e ka ke ya nna PEP.

ownership.over_allocated: {entity}: diabe tse di boletsweng di fitlha go {declared}%, e leng go feta khamphani yotlhe.
ownership.related_help: Barekisi ba ba nang le motho kgotsa khamphani e e tshwereng e e tshwanang le yono. Gantsi ga go molato — mme gape ke tsela e setlhopha se le sengwe se tsenyang thendara ka maina a mararo.

report_sources.adjustments: E tsoswa tekanyetsong jaaka koketso, phokotso goba phetisetso.

budgets_planning.title: Peakanyo ya tekanyetso
budgets_planning.subtitle: Fetisetsa ngwaga, tsenya o mongwe go tswa go spreadsheet, mme o tswalele wo o felilego.
budgets_planning.years_sub: Kabo ka dinako e nyaka dinako; ngwaga wo o se nago tsona ga o na leano la go bapetsa le tshomiso.

budgets_planning.carry_notice: Tsohle di fihla jaaka dithaellwa. Ga go seo se somago go fihlela motho a se dumelela.
budgets_planning.import_sub: CSV, go tswa thwii go spreadsheet yeo potoloko e thomilego go yona.
budgets_planning.import_notice: Mela e lekolwa e tee ka e tee. Mola wo mobe o begwa ka nomoro ya mola; ye e lokilego e sa tsenywa, jaaka dithaellwa.
budgets_planning.template_sub: Faele yeo motsenyi a e balago ka nnete, ka mela ye mebedi ya mohlala e tladitswe.

budgets_planning.how_title: Ka fao go laisa go somago ka gona
budgets_planning.how_1: Mola wa mathomo o swanetse go ba wa hlogo. Maina a bapetswa ntle le go lebelela ditlhaka tse dikgolo mme dikgoba di ba di-underscore, ka fao “Allocated Amount” le “allocated_amount” ke kholomo e tee.
budgets_planning.how_2: Tatelano ya dikholomo ga e na taba, mme dikholomo tseo o sa di nyakego di ka tlogelwa faeleng ka mo go feletsego.
budgets_planning.how_3: Mola o mongwe le o mongwe o lekolwa o nnosi. Mola wo o palelwago o begwa ka nomoro ya wona faeleng mme o tlodiswa — e setsego e sa tsenywa.
budgets_planning.how_4: Tsohle di fihla jaaka dithaellwa. Ga go seo se somago, mme ga go seo se tsenago mothalading wa ditumelelo go fihlela motho a se romela.
budgets_planning.how_5: Boleng bjoo motsenyi a sa bo tsebego — legoro leo le ngwadilwego gampe goba mohuta wa tshenyagalelo — ga bo dire gore mola o palelwe. Bo boela ka tlwaelo mme bo ngwalwa jaaka temoso ka morago.
budgets_planning.how_6: Ga go seo se tloswago ga bobedi. Go laisa faele ye e swanago gabedi go tlhama ditekanyetso gabedi, ka fao tsenya faele ye e lokisitswego ngwageng wo mofsa goba o phumole dithaellwa pele.

budgets_planning.col_help_expenditure_type: E boela go opex ge e se na selo goba e sa tsebje.
budgets_planning.col_help_category: E swanetse go swana le le lengwe la maina a magoro ka fase. Leina leo le sa swanego le tlogela tekanyetso e se na legoro mme le tsosa temoso.

Ga o dire kgotsa go atlenegisa dipholo tsa go thapa, go leleka kgotsa tsa maitsholo. Go tshwana ga leina ga se netefatso ya boitshupo. Dirisa fela ka tetla le go dumalana le molao wa sephiri le wa badiri.

Go lebelelwa tshedimosetso ya BOTLHE fela — e seng diakhaonto tsa poraefete. Diphitlhelelo di a tlhalosega, di na le boitshepo le motswedi, di tlotla nako ya polokelo e e fa tlase, di laolwa ka phitlhelelo mme di sekasekwa ka botlalo, mme ga di ke di dirisediwa ditshwetso tsa tiro tse di itiragalang.
